name: unicorn
description: The memory layer of your own campus AI agent: door MCP tools, the four playbooks as skills, and a SessionStart hook that pulls unread briefs.

url.title: Worker URL
url.description: Your self-deployed unicorn Worker's base URL, e.g. https://unicorn.<you>.workers.dev (no trailing slash, no /mcp).

token.title: MCP token
token.description: The MCP_TOKEN bearer secret your unicorn Worker was deployed with.
